name: Tear Ticket
description: An interactive ticket for React whose perforated stub tears off by hand: it swings about the far end of a cleanly cut perforation, each paper bridge stretches into fibres and snaps (nearest first), and the stub hangs from your hand, then falls with your throw. The ticket greys out and gets stamped. 3D tilt; no dependencies.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the ticket body, over the foot of the artwork.

props.name: image
props.description: Artwork on the body. It fades to grey once the ticket is used.

props.name: onTear
props.description: Fires once the stub has come free and dropped away.

props.name: tearAngle
props.description: How far the stub may swing about its hinge before it must come free, in degrees.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How far a paper bridge between two holes stretches before it snaps, in px.

props.name: resistance
props.description: How hard the paper still joined holds the stub back (0–0.95).

props.name: tilt
props.description: 3D tilt toward the pointer in degrees. 0 turns it off.

props.name: holes
props.description: Perforation holes along the tear line.

props.name: width / height / stubSize
props.description: Ticket size and stub width in px. The ticket scales down to fit a narrower parent.

props.name: radius / holeSize / notch
props.description: Corner radius, hole diameter and end-notch radius in px.

props.name: tiltReach / parallax
props.description: How far from the ticket the pointer still tilts it, and the artwork's parallax, in px.
